name: GDInput Buffer
description: Configurable jump buffer for Geometry Dash. Press F6 or use the settings to cycle stages.

buffer-stage.name: Buffer stage
buffer-stage.description: 1 = NOOB (4 ticks), 2 = PRO (8), 3 = BEST MODE (16), 4 = BEST MODE + (32), 5 = OFF. F6 also cycles this on keyboard.

verbose-log.name: Detailed logging
verbose-log.description: Print queued and applied input events to the Geode log.
